name: Fawaterk For WooCommerce
author: fawaterak

sections.description:
The fawaterk Payment Gateway plugin allows merchants to accept secure online payments via the fawaterk platform.
It provides a seamless checkout experience, supports multiple currencies, and integrates smoothly with WooCommerce stores.

Features

  • Accept credit/debit card payments through fawaterk.
  • Secure communication using API keys.
  • Compatible with the latest WooCommerce and WordPress versions.
  • Supports sandbox and live modes.
  • Customizable checkout form and responsive design.

Compatibility

This plugin is compatible with WooCommerce but is not affiliated with or endorsed by WooCommerce or Automattic Inc.

External Services

This plugin connects to external services operated by Fawaterk to process payments:

  • Production: https://app.fawaterk.com — Used when Test Mode is disabled. Order and customer data (e.g. name, email, phone, address, order total, payment method) are sent to create and process invoices.
  • Staging: https://staging.fawaterk.com — Used when Test Mode is enabled for testing.

Data sent to these services includes: billing and shipping details, order items and totals, and payment method selection. This is required to create invoices and complete payment processing.

For more information, see Fawaterk’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy:

  • Terms of Service: https://fawaterk.com/terms (or your provider’s URL)
  • Privacy Policy: https://fawaterk.com/privacy (or your provider’s URL)

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not store or share personal user data beyond what is necessary for processing payments through fawaterk.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/fawaterk-gateway directory, or install directly through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments → fawaterk and enter your API credentials.
  4. Enable the gateway and save your changes.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require a fawaterk account?

Yes. You need to have a fawaterk merchant account with API credentials.

Does this plugin work with test mode?

Yes. You can switch between test and live modes in the plugin settings.

Is this plugin official?

This plugin was developed by fawaterk developers using the public fawaterk API.
It is not affiliated with or endorsed by WooCommerce or Automattic Inc.
